description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various categories across a dataset, with each slice representing a distinct topic and its corresponding proportion. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to "AI/NLP Research" and accounts for 24.3% of the total. The second-largest category is "Game&Anime," shown in orange, making up 8.2% of the dataset. "History" is represented by a yellow slice and comprises 8.2% as well. "Science" and "Med & Health" are both depicted in light blue and light green respectively, each contributing 6.7% to the total. "Law" is shown in red and accounts for 5.1%, while "Pet & Animal" is represented by a green slice at 5.5%. "Daily Life" is shown in light teal and makes up 7.1%. "Business" is depicted in dark red and represents 5.9%, "Geography" in yellow is 2.7%, and "Math" is shown in a very small green slice at 1.2%. The chart uses labels and lines to connect each category to its respective slice, with percentage values clearly indicated. The slices are arranged in a circular format, with the largest segment positioned at the top right and the others following in a clockwise direction, creating a clear visual hierarchy based on size.
